name: Archery
description: Unlocks crafting recurve bows from leather.

name: Fortifications
description: Unlocks sandbags for cover and embrasures to shoot through.

name: Hearths
description: Unlocks the stone hearth, a much stronger heater than a campfire.

name: Insulation
description: Rooms lose heat half as fast.

name: Comfortable bedding
description: Unlocks the fine bed: prettier, and colonists rest 25% faster in it.

name: Field medicine
description: Doctors tend wounds and illness noticeably better.

name: Electricity
description: Unlocks the wood-fired generator and the electric heater.

name: Refrigeration
description: Unlocks iceboxes, freezer units and air conditioners.

name: Sun lamps
description: Unlocks sun lamps: crops beneath them grow day and night, all year.

name: Tailoring
description: Unlocks tailoring tunics from cloth and warm parkas from leather.

name: Longbows
description: Unlocks the longbow: the longest reach of any bow.

name: Crossbows
description: Unlocks the crossbow: slow to load, but its bolts punch through armor.

name: Armor
description: Unlocks leather armor, which turns aside a quarter of every blow.

name: Scale armor
description: Unlocks scale armor of granite plates: heavy, but stops nearly half of every blow.

name: Traps
description: Unlocks spike traps that wound the first raider to step on them.

name: Optics
description: Unlocks the telescope: stargazing on clear nights, outdoors.

name: Fine arts
description: Unlocks the grand sculpture: granite and silver, the finest piece a colony can make.
